headline.purpose: Page, section and dialog titles; Geist 700, -0.01em.

tally.purpose: The ledger figures in the company head; tabular numerals, 1.15rem under 640px.

body.purpose: Everything read: copy, controls, menus, table cells; 500 for controls/links, 700 only for current/selected.

label.purpose: Tally labels, table headers, stamps, card meta; sentence case, never uppercase or tracked.

ref.purpose: Geist Mono strictly for references and IDs via .fx-ref; nowhere else.

shadows.name: shadow
shadows.purpose: The token itself is none: no surface casts a shadow at rest, on hover, or raised.

shadows.name: shadow-lift
shadows.purpose: No lift state exists; depth is a 1px rule or one tone step.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Input focus halo (--oxide-wash) with the border turning ink; a ring, not elevation.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The single easing for every transition and animation.

motion.name: shelf-stagger
motion.value: fx-reveal 260ms, 30ms per child, capped at 210ms delay
motion.purpose: The staggered rise as the record shelf arrives; the flow's one deliberate motion moment.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Every button and the logo press under the pointer.

motion.name: hover-transitions
motion.purpose: Quiet state changes on buttons, cards, rows, links.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce kills all animation, transition and smooth scroll globally (0.01ms)
motion.purpose: WCAG 2.3.3: people who ask for less motion get none.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Top bar collapses below; folder cards drop their face; register sheds columns; tallies shrink.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Reference column appears in the register.

narrative.overview: A business ledger as working software. The chrome carries no colour at all: ink on a blue-grey paper ground, one near-black primary action, a grey-pill secondary, figures set with tabular numerals like entries in well-kept books. The single data hue (#1d5fbf) exists for exactly one job — marking the screen's main data element — and nothing else. Distinction comes from exactness — hairlines, spacing rhythm, type discipline, one accent — never from world material, texture or costume. Surfaces are flat; separation is a 1px rule or one tone step, never a shadow at rest. Sentence case everywhere, no tracked capitals. The dark theme is the same ledger at night: the primary inverts to a white pill with ink text, the data hue lifts to #7ba4ec, the flat discipline holds.
keyCharacteristics: No colour anywhere in the chrome; the one accent is near-black.
One data hue with exactly one consumer.
Flat surfaces, 1px rules, zero shadow at rest (--shadow: none is a token).
Geist everywhere read; Geist Mono strictly for references and IDs.
Tabular numerals on everything that counts; sentence case throughout.
Every number on screen is a real query — nothing fabricated.

rules.name: The One Hue Rule
rules.body: The data hue (#1d5fbf / dark #7ba4ec) marks only the screen's main data element — today, the non-zero "shared outside" tally. It never touches a button, a link, a nav item, or an icon. A second consumer needs an owner decision, not a precedent.

rules.name: The Achromatic Chrome Rule
rules.body: Buttons, navigation, inputs, borders and text are ink and grey only. The only tinted elements besides the data hue are the status stamp/notice pairs (moss/amber/danger), and they stay inside pills, notes and destructive controls.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Sentence case everywhere; no tracked capitals, no uppercase labels anywhere in the product. Even table headers are 12px lowercase-led grey text.

rules.name: The Mono-For-References Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono appears only inside .fx-ref — references and IDs. Never paragraphs, never labels, never numerals outside a reference.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums on every element that counts: tallies, card meta, the register, references, selection counts.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow at rest, on hover, or when raised. If a surface needs separation, give it a 1px --line rule or move it one tone step.

dos: Do keep the chrome achromatic: ink (#0a0a0a), greys, and the near-black primary (#141414) are the entire action palette.
Do reserve #1d5fbf (dark #7ba4ec) for the main data element only — today that is the non-zero "shared outside" tally via .fx-tally--data.
Do separate surfaces with a 1px #e6e6e6 rule or one tone step; --shadow stays none.
Do set every figure tabular, and every reference or ID in Geist Mono inside .fx-ref.
Do build new UI from the fx- component layer and the :root tokens; both themes come free, and Tailwind utilities handle layout only.
Do give every flow exactly one deliberate motion moment (shelf stagger, stamp-in, press), and let reduced-motion remove all of it.
donts: Don't put colour on a button, link, nav item or icon — not the data hue, not a brand hue. Moss/amber/red exist only inside stamps, notes and destructive controls.
Don't add shadows, gradients, textures or costume anywhere; distinction is exactness, not material.
Don't use uppercase or letter-spaced labels; sentence case everywhere, 700 weight only for headings and the current/selected item.
Don't load fonts or type from a CDN in the product shell; Geist and Geist Mono are self-hosted in public/fonts.
Don't import the landing page's system (Fraunces/Work Sans/IBM Plex Mono, welcome.blade.php) into the product, or push the ledger onto the landing page — they are deliberately separate worlds.
Don't fabricate numbers, counts or previews to fill a layout; every figure on screen is a real query (PRODUCT.md).
